floor_history.headline: recon s1: honest pure-C floor 21 (inherited 16 was register-asm-pin cheat scaffold, forbidden by policy); gap decomposes into phantom -8 frame + outer-loop D_800A389B CSE reload + register-rename resi
Honest pure-C floor 21 -> 11 (build_insns now 40 == target): goto-form outer loop restores the D_800A389B tail reload, tail increment order kills the load-delay nop, and OR-ing straight into acc puts

frontier.hypothesis: base>shift allocno ordering is reachable by changing a reference COUNT (not an order) while keeping all 40 instructions
frontier.mechanism: priority = floor_log2(n_refs)*n_refs/live_length; the single-sllv variant proves the target triple is reachable purely by lowering shift's ref count. Order-preserving mutations are measured inert, so the next probe must add a reference to `base` or remove/relocate one of `shift`'s four references without changing the emitted instruction count.
frontier.next_probe: Build an instrumented cc1 under tmp/gccdbg (canonical cc1 untouched, explicitly sanctioned by register-alloc-pure-c) that prints allocno_n_refs and allocno_live_length per allocno. Read the exact numbers for shift(72) and base(76) in the score-11 form, compute how many refs or how much live-length is needed to cross the floor_log2 step, then target that delta specifically instead of sweeping blind.

frontier.hypothesis: The preheader `addiu $t2,$zero,3` can be produced without a constant-holder local and without outer-LICM
frontier.mechanism: With the goto-form outer loop there is no outer LICM, so the preheader can only receive code from source statements placed before the `outer:` label. The constant-holder spelling was measured to give no floor gain, so a different producer is needed - e.g. a form where 3 is materialised as a by-product of a real preheader computation, or where the inner-LICM preheader coincides with the outer preheader.
frontier.next_probe: Probe forms where the inner loop is peeled/restructured so its LICM preheader lands before the outer label, and forms where the else-arm value is derived from an expression already evaluated in the preheader. Measure `li 3` slot position in the cc1 .s; the standalone harness makes each probe ~1s.

frontier.hypothesis: decomp-permuter, seeded from the score-11 base, can find the remaining ref-count lever
frontier.mechanism: The remaining gap is a single allocno-priority step plus one instruction placement; the permuter's type-mutation and statement-restructuring passes explore exactly the ref-count space that hand mutation has now been shown not to cover. Prior sessions ran the permuter only from the far-worse s1 base.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean single-function target.o from asm/funcs/func_80034200.s + prelude.inc (so the function sits at offset 0 and the score is the real weighted diff), import the score-11 candidate as base.c, and run with --stop-on-zero plus the fresh-seed stopping rule from permuter-fresh-seed-discipline. Harvest and stop the campaign in-session.
